rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for putting a physical thing out of sight.

example.english: I conceal the documents in the drawer.
example.traditional: 我將啲文件收埋喺櫃桶入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin6 sau1 maai4 hai2 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this when concealing information or the truth from someone.

example.english: Don't conceal it from me—I already know.
example.traditional: 你唔好瞞住我，件事我已經知喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 mun4 zyu6 ngo5 gin6 si6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 zi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this formal word for deliberately withholding facts or concealing the truth.

example.english: The company deliberately chose to conceal the truth about the accident.
example.traditional: 公司刻意隱瞞事故真相。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 hak1 ji3 jan2 mun4 si6 gu3 zan1 soeng3
